title: Wall mounting details.
officialText:
Chains, cables, guys or steel rods used to support the live or dead load of projecting signs are
permitted to be fastened to solid masonry walls with expansion bolts or by machine screws in iron supports, but such supports shall
not be attached to an unbraced parapet wall. Where the supports must be fastened to walls made of wood, the supporting anchor
bolts must go through the wall and be plated or fastened on the inside in a secure manner.
